{{Otheruses|Ministry of Supply}}
The '''Ministry of Supply''' was a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], responsible for coordinating New Republic supply convoys. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], on two occasions, supply convoys carrying [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were reported to have been the source of tight-beam transmissions associated with [[espionage droid]]s.<ref name="Wanted by Cracken sourcebook">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>
